worker_claim.report: Runtime now retains only the owner/shutdown-enforcing executor as its raw Git launch seam; mutation call sites use semantic operations and preserve existing leases, retries, and re-observation.
worker_claim.summary: Extracted runtime Git mutation construction into explicit typed operations for create-if-absent refs, CAS refs, unconditional refs, transport, worktrees, lifecycle commits, merges, resets, and evidence objects. Preserved ServiceEngine ownership and interruption seams, added command-trace regression tests, and documented effect classes and WAL/re-observation boundaries in docs/GIT_COMMAND_INVENTORY.md.
